summary: Diff adds a new /search route and SearchPage, plus lightweight client-side search utilities and header/mobile navigation entry points. Core search logic (case-insensitive, trimmed/normalized, deterministic ordering) appears implemented. However, some REQ-25/REQ-26 acceptance criteria cannot be fully verified from the truncated SearchPage diff, and desktop header search does not appear to support submitting a query to /search?q=... from the header itself.

missing_requirements.requirement: Submitting a search from the desktop header navigates to the Search page and includes the query in the URL (e.g., /search?q=term).
missing_requirements.reason: SiteHeader only provides a search icon button that navigates to /search with no query input or submission behavior, so it cannot pre-fill the query via URL parameter from the desktop header.

missing_requirements.requirement: Results are shown as a responsive grid/list of existing UpdateCard components, and clicking a card navigates to the existing /post/$postId detail page.
missing_requirements.reason: SearchPage is truncated before the results rendering portion; the diff excerpt does not show the grid/list rendering or click-through behavior to /post/$postId (it may exist but is not present in the provided diff summary).

missing_requirements.requirement: When there are zero matches, the page shows a clear “No results found” state with a suggestion to try different keywords.
missing_requirements.reason: SearchPage is truncated; while it computes showNoResults, the provided excerpt does not show the UI for the no-results state or suggestion text.
